# Quick Text — Full Reference

## Overview

Quick Text is a Raycast extension for transforming selected text with local AI. Instead of the usual copy → open chat → paste → prompt → wait → copy → paste loop, the user selects text, opens Raycast, runs the "Quick Text" command, and picks an action. Text is processed locally via Ollama, so it never leaves the user's machine.

- Platform: Raycast (macOS)
- Author: Carlos Espinoza (Carloss616)
- Repository: https://github.com/Carloss616/quick-text
- License: MIT

## Features

- Fix Grammar — correct spelling and grammar mistakes.
- Paraphrase — rewrite text with different wording.
- Change Tone — adjust tone (formal, casual, professional, etc.).
- Summarize — condense longer text into a concise summary.
- Translate — translate text into another language.
- Model Selector — choose among any Ollama models the user has pulled.
- Copy & Paste Actions — copy the processed result or paste it back in place.
- Fully local — all inference runs through a local Ollama instance.

## Requirements

- Raycast (https://raycast.com/)
- Ollama (https://ollama.ai/) running locally with at least one model pulled, e.g. `ollama pull granite4:350m`

## Preferences

- Ollama Server URL — URL of the local Ollama instance. Default: http://localhost:11434

## Quick Start

1. Pull a model: `ollama pull granite4:350m`
2. Clone: `git clone https://github.com/Carloss616/quick-text.git`
3. Install: `npm install`
4. Run in Raycast: `npm run dev`
5. Select text, open Raycast, run "Quick Text", pick an action.

## Scripts

- `npm run dev` — ray develop (live extension in Raycast)
- `npm run build` — ray build -e dist
- `npm run lint` / `npm run fix-lint` — ray lint
- `npm run typecheck` — tsc --noEmit
- `npm run publish` — publish to the Raycast Store

## Architecture

Single Raycast command ("quick-text", view mode). Structure under `src/`:

- commands/quick-text-command/quick-text-command.tsx — main command view
- commands/quick-text-command/components/text-actions.ts — the transform action definitions
- commands/quick-text-command/components/text-action-item.tsx — list item per action
- commands/quick-text-command/components/no-model-item.tsx — shown when no model is available
- components/copy-and-paste-actions.tsx — copy/paste result actions
- components/model-selector-dropdown.tsx — model picker
- components/model-setup-actions.tsx — model setup helpers
- components/text-processor-detail.tsx — detail view of processed output
- hooks/use-ollama.ts — Ollama client and text processing
- hooks/use-selected-text.ts — reads the current selection
- utils/ollama-setup.ts — model discovery / setup helpers
- utils/size.ts — sizing helpers
- quick-text.tsx — entry point

## Tech Stack

- Raycast API ^1.75 (@raycast/api, @raycast/utils)
- TypeScript 5
- React 19
- Ollama client ^0.6 (ollama)
- npm (package manager), ESLint, Prettier

## Roadmap

- Done: fix grammar, paraphrase, summarize, translate, change tone; local Ollama processing; model selector; copy & paste actions.
- Planned: publish to the Raycast Store; custom user-defined actions; streaming output.
